# CyberBen

> Independent aviation cybersafety advisory based in Tallinn, Estonia (CyberBen OÜ). We help manufacturers, operators, service providers and regulators build cyber resilience across the whole product life-cycle: airworthiness security, EASA Part-IS, training, certification support, and assurance of AI in aviation.

The new cybersafety.aero is in pre-flight: only a holding page is online for now. The full site follows in early 2027.

Contact: hello@cybersafety.aero · Security reports: security@cybersafety.aero (PGP available)

## Pages

- [Home](https://cybersafety.aero/): holding page while the new site is in final checks.
- [Security](https://cybersafety.aero/security): vulnerability disclosure policy.

## Optional

- [cyberben.ai](https://cyberben.ai/): a scripted terminal about AI assurance in aviation.
